name: computer
description: A real graphical computer for the space: a full GUI web browser running on a virtual desktop and streamed live over VNC. The desktop runs on the space's own cloud sandbox (the Modal/Vercel microVM the sandbox tool provides) — the first time it is opened this tool installs and starts the desktop there (browser + VNC + secure Cloudflare tunnel), streaming the setup log; after that it detects the running desktop and returns instantly. People watch and drive the browser with mouse/touch/keyboard inside the app; agents drive the same desktop by taking screenshots and issuing click/type/key/scroll/navigate actions. Use it when a task needs a visible, interactive browser a person can also take over.
usecases: you need a graphical browser a human can watch and take over with mouse/keyboard, not just a headless one
you (an agent) need to see the screen and click/type by coordinates like a person would
you need to hand a live, interactive browser session to the people in the space
a task mixes agent automation and human steps on the same browser (logins, captchas, review)
howToTalk: Signal it with `function` naming the operation. `open` provisions or reuses the space's desktop and returns its phase and, once ready, the public VNC `url` (the front-end opens that in Victor's webview). Poll `status` (pass a `cursor` to page new install-log lines). `url` returns just the ready URL. Drive the desktop with `screenshot` (base64 `image`; `format`=png|jpeg), `click` (`x`,`y`,`button`=left|right|middle, `double`), `move` (`x`,`y`), `type` (`text`), `key` (`key`, e.g. Return, ctrl+l, alt+Tab), `scroll` (`to`=up|down or `dy`), and `navigate` (`url`). `stop` tears the desktop down; `restart` rebuilds it.
prompt: This is a real graphical computer with a visible web browser for the space, running on the space's cloud sandbox and streamed over VNC. Call `open` first — it installs and starts the desktop on the sandbox on first use (streaming an install log) or returns instantly if it is already up, giving you a `url` the people in the space open to watch and control the browser. To act yourself, `screenshot` to see the screen, then `click`/`move` by pixel coordinates, `type` text, press `key` combos (Return, ctrl+l, …), `scroll`, or `navigate` to a URL. You and the humans share the same desktop, so coordinate: take a screenshot before acting.

function.description: operation: open (default) | status | url | screenshot | click | move | type | key | scroll | navigate | stop | restart

cursor.description: for open/status: the log cursor from the previous reply, to fetch only new install-log lines

url.description: for navigate: the page URL to open in the desktop browser

x.description: for click/move: the X pixel coordinate on the desktop

y.description: for click/move: the Y pixel coordinate on the desktop

text.description: for type: the text to type into the focused element

key.description: for key: a key or chord, e.g. Return, Escape, ctrl+l, alt+Tab

to.description: for scroll: up | down (or use dy for a pixel delta)

tools.name: open
tools.desc: provision (first time — streams an install log) or reuse the space's graphical desktop; returns its phase and, once ready, the public VNC url the front-end opens in Victor's webview

cursor.desc: the log cursor from a previous reply, to fetch only new lines

widget.heading: Computer
widget.note: Open the Computer tool on the space desktop to watch and control the browser.

tools.name: status
tools.desc: the desktop's current phase (idle|installing|ready|error), the ready url, and any new install-log lines since your cursor

cursor.desc: the log cursor from a previous reply

tools.name: url
tools.desc: the ready public VNC url for the space's desktop (or a not-ready message)

tools.name: screenshot
tools.desc: capture the desktop screen and return a base64 image (what an agent looks at before acting)

tools.name: click
tools.desc: click at a pixel coordinate on the desktop

tools.name: move
tools.desc: move the mouse pointer to a pixel coordinate

tools.name: type
tools.desc: type text into the focused element

tools.name: key
tools.desc: press a keyboard key or chord (on the focused element)

tools.name: scroll
tools.desc: scroll the desktop up or down

tools.name: navigate
tools.desc: open a URL in the desktop browser

tools.name: stop
tools.desc: tear the space's desktop down (frees the display, VNC and tunnel)

tools.desc: rebuild the space's desktop from scratch
